title: docs(spec): nine migration-step rationale passages and two registry comments drop their deleted tracker numbers (stage 11)
body:
Part of #20234

Clause-②: no

Stage 11 of the dead-citation sweep: the hand-written parts of `packages/spec/src/migrations/registry.ts`, under ruling C+D (record `5749154545` on #19123). At base, those parts carried 13 sites citing deleted tracker numbers: 2 in source comments and 11 in step rationale text that authors read. A step `rationale` is author-shown: `os migrate meta` prints it per hop, and step 17's is projected into `docs/protocol-upgrade-guide.md`. Text only. No step, fragment id, fragment order, generated entry, conversion or code token moves.

- **Form C, the 2 comments.** Each dead number now cites the commit that decided it (verified against the commit's own text), and the sentence says what that commit did.
- **Form D, the 11 rationale sites.** They sit in 9 rationale units: step 17's `mongodb` paragraph and 8 step-18 fragments (a fragment is "one retirement's sentences"). Each of those 9 units now carries no number at all. The 11 dead numbers go, and so do the 11 live numbers in the same units, because form D removes every number from author-visible text. Each sentence states the cited decision in words, read from its decision record, not its title.
- **Regenerated, never hand-edited:** `docs/protocol-upgrade-guide.md` line 68. `check:generated --fix` proved it the only stale artifact of 15. `gen:migration-registry` has nothing to do, because no generated region mirrors a rationale.
- One `@objectstack/spec` **patch** changeset.

## What changes

Line numbers are at base `e909aa0a23`. "Dead" means `GET issues/N` answers 404, with no redirect followed.

Where a commit message does not name its number, the anchor was confirmed from the files that commit added: c459da6bc, 9e0ba21a1 and bc56e1881 each carry their number in their own diff. Both sha anchors added to comments are unambiguous: `rev-parse --disambiguate` count 1, and `GET commits/SHA` returns the full sha (a 4-character control returns 422). `merge-base --is-ancestor` answers 0 for all 11 anchors. The checkout is shallow, with a boundary of 2026-06-28. Every anchor is later than that, and exit 0 proves ancestry on its own.

## What stays, and why (counts left on #20234)

- **Live numbers in comments: 46 sites (plus 1 cross-repo).** The rule applies to dead citations in comments, so these stay.
- **Live numbers in author-visible rationale text outside the 9 units: 192 sites** (175 in-repo, 17 cross-repo; 142 distinct in-repo numbers). Step 17 holds 116 of them and step 18 holds 76. Form D would remove them too, but they are not dead citations, and they lie outside this stage's claimed surface. Note that #20749 (the runtime-string burn-down) counts migration-registry text as its share, yet both of its stage claims (`5965785560`, `5966674486`) exclude `migrations/registry.ts` as "#20234's stage 11". So no stage currently covers them. `migrations.test.ts` pins one of them, the live #4722 in step 17, so whichever stage takes them moves that pin. This is reported as the open question.
- The 6 dead numbers from census pointer `5923089344` are outside this stage, as dispatched.

## Verification

**Deadness.** A TypeScript 6.0.3 walker runs the citation gate's own `extractCitations` over two projections of the file (comment-only and string-only, line structure kept). It classes each site by kind and by region; the generated regions are the 6 `os-generated` pairs. At base, the hand-written parts hold 262 sites: 48 in comments (1 cross-repo) and 214 in rationale strings (19 cross-repo), over 177 distinct in-repo numbers. A REST probe of all 177 (`issues/N`, no redirect followed; lit control #20234 and dead control #8710 at the start, after every 50 and at the end): 165 answer 200, 12 answer 404, and 0 answer 301. Controls behaved 5/5 lit and 5/5 dead. The 12 numbers sit on exactly the 13 sites stage 10 named (`5902947213`). At head, the 162 distinct numbers all answer 200 (controls 5/5 and 5/5), and 0 dead sites remain. Site-set difference: 24 removed (13 dead and 11 live, all inside the 9 units) and 1 added (#8666, live, the PR link beside commit 4bfe1a539 in a comment, which form C allows). The 911 sites in generated regions do not change.

**Text only.** A second instrument over TypeScript 6.0.3 evaluates the step-17 `rationale` and every step-18 fragment `text` (72 owners). It masks each of those initializers to one token that names its owner and cuts every comment, JSDoc included. The base and head leaf-token streams are IDENTICAL: 37,526 tokens, sha256 prefix `647bc09580ac619e` on both sides. Evaluated values changed for exactly 9 owners, the units listed above, and each word diff is the citation and its replacement words only. Controls mutate the head in memory: a comment insertion stays IDENTICAL, and each of these DIFFERS: a fragment `order` change, a fragment `id` change, an unmasked string edit, a conversion-id string edit, and an appended declaration (6/6).

**Regeneration.** Before regeneration, `check:migration-registry` and `check:spec-changes` exit 0, and `check:upgrade-guide` exits 1. `check:generated --fix` regenerated only the guide. Its word diff on line 68 shows `mongodb` (#6345). becoming `mongodb`. and #4410 becoming the decision in words. After the `origin/main` merge (`6dd99b82c3`, through `os-regen-merge.sh`, which touched none of these paths), a rebuild plus `check:generated` reports "All 15 generated artifacts are up to date". No regeneration commit was owed.

**Pins and quotes.** No test asserts a changed phrase. `content/docs/**` and `skills/**` quote none of them. The other hits for the old spellings are independent comments in other files (live numbers), release-owned CHANGELOGs and one test title, all left alone.

**Tests and gates** (at head `64bbd3693e`; all builds and tests through `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`, each VERDICT command-exit 0):
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build`, and a full `turbo run build --concurrency=2` over `./packages/*` and `./packages/*/*` (71/71).
- spec local project: Test Files 606 passed, Tests 17952 passed, 1 todo.
- spec repo project, 47 of its 51 files by name: 47 passed, 750 tests, including `scripts/step18-rationale-merge.test.ts`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck`: `check:test-typecheck` OK.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`: 85 families derived, 85 run, all exit 0, reconciled with `--ran` ("0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN"). That includes `check:doc-authoring` (self-test and run), `check:issue-citations`, `check:nul-bytes`, `check:generated`, `check:migration-registry`, `check:upgrade-guide` and the changeset gates. Three of them first exited 3 (prerequisite: unbuilt dist) and were rerun green after the full build.
- Lint, as a proven narrowing: `eslint --no-inline-config --format json` over the one touched `.ts` file reports 1 file, 0 errors, 0 warnings, and `isPathIgnored` is false. `eslint.config.mjs:327-328` states that type-aware linting is never enabled, so a text edit cannot move an untouched file's verdict. The repo-wide `pnpm lint` is CI's run.
- NOT MEASURED, declared to CI as in stages 8 to 10: `scripts/build-schemas-check-mode.test.ts` (it overran the foreground cap on its own in stage 10; it parses this file's source, whose code tokens the text-only proof shows unchanged), plus `def-key-collisions` and the two `publish-smoke-*` files (temp-tree rebuild or server boot).

**Changeset.** `packages/spec` `files[]` ships `dist`. In the built dist, the new phrases appear in 2 files (`dist/migrations/index.js`, `.mjs`), the old spellings in 0, and an unchanged control phrase in the same 2. Hence `patch`.

## Acceptance notes

- **Open, for the seat:** whether the 192 live author-visible numbers become a stage, and on which card (#20234, or #20749 whose stages currently exclude this file). They are not filed.
- **Gate coverage boundary (carrier: none; noted, not filed):** the citation gate reads comment prose only, so these 11 dead rationale sites were never in its census. Stage 9 recorded the same boundary for conversion summaries.
